subject: Working w/ ElevenLabs & Soundhound | Aura-2
text:
Hi [NAME],​

I just read about Aura-2's low-latency performance & thought I'd reach out. I lead a Conversational AI team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) - we're actually working with a few of your peers (Synthesia, ElevenLabs, Captions, Soundhound, etc) on developing new models / improving existing ones for use cases like ASR, TTS, STT, NER, etc. 

For context, I met some of your colleagues at NVIDA GTC who mentioned that it might be interesting to get connected. Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building here if you have 15 mins to chat over the coming weeks? I'm usually open Thursday / Friday.

subject: Attending CVPR | quick coffee?
text:

Assuming you and the [COMPANY] team might be in Nashville for CVPR this year? Would be great to get a coffee and swap notes on the work we're doing in computer vision / multimodal model dev.
